task_name: Upgrade Residential Buildings to Reach City Level 3

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When residential zones display yellow hard hats with green checkmarks and sufficient Metal and Nails are collected.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Completing these residential upgrades pushes city population to 570 and levels the city up to Level 3, unlocking the Parks specialization, Planks production, and an additional Small Factory.
preconditions: Metal and Nails available in City Storage
Ready hard hat indicators on residential buildings
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Drag required Metal and Nails onto each ready residential building.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the lower-left residential building

steps.briefing: drag Metal onto the building to start upgrading.

steps.who: floating Nails on Building Supplies Store and floating Metal on northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect the finished Nails and Metal, then re-queue Metal in the factories and Nails in the store.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the rightmost Residential Zone

steps.briefing: drag the materials onto the zone to construct it and reach City Level 3.
